title: Mission Launch Visual Polish Foundation
goal: Make intake-to-execution feel intentional and premium while keeping every visual cue grounded in real state.
scope: Implement a small mission-launch sequence and continue calming ambient scan-grid/orbit styling. Use existing run, task, and selected-profile state only; do not add fake telemetry or backend behavior.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found mission launch and visual-ceiling work needed an explicit queued package.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Polish only the intake-to-run transition and ambient styling. Do not add fake progress, fake findings, or new backend events.
notes: Motion must be short, state-driven, and accessible.
Calmer styling should improve boardroom credibility without hiding operational state.

success_criteria: Mission launch has a clear transition from confirmed mission to queued or active run.
Visual effects reflect actual state and do not imply nonexistent execution.
Scan-grid and ambient effects are reduced, contained, or made less visually dominant.
Browser tests cover launch transition and no-run fallback behavior.
Reduced-motion or non-animated behavior remains usable.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Launch polish is visible without creating fake operational state.
Calmer visual styling remains readable on desktop and narrow screens.
No backend or runtime behavior changes are bundled.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Existing mission creation and dispatch states are inspected before animation work starts.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with launch-polish changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the visual-polish baseline and remaining UI limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
